title: The Paste on the Paper Star
youtube_title: The Paste on the Paper Star | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Idris wants to check on a paper star with paste still shining before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Idris leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
